title: Lion Tail Character Poses
description: Three vertical panels display the same anime-style female character with a lion tail and steampunk outfit. Left panel shows her standing dynamically with one hand raised, middle panel captures her mid-air in a falling pose, right panel shows her lying on the ground after impact.
prompt: Anime style illustration of a young female character with spiky black hair, yellow goggles, and a mechanical lion tail, wearing a yellow and black steampunk jacket with belts, shorts, and boots. Three vertical panels on a green gradient background: standing pose with hand raised, mid-air falling pose, and lying on the ground after falling. Bold line art, vibrant colors, dynamic action sequence.
